entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Alex Chen, order number 774-B-91. Just need the return details.
Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. And just for my notes, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no issue. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I simply don't use it. I don't need troubleshooting, I just need to send it back.
Okay, I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just check the delivery date here to confirm eligibility... one moment.
Alright, I see it was delivered 22 days ago. According to our policy here, you have 90 days to return an item, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Great. So you're sending a label?

Yes. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 5 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
